svg:
Kundt's tube: standing waves in gas column, measurement of v_gas / v_rod
glass tube with cork dust, closed at both ends <line x1="100" y1="110" x2="600" y2="110" stroke="#1f5fa8" stroke-width:1" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
nodes: dust piles where displacement 0 (pressure antinode)
metal rod clamped at middle rod vibrates longitudinally: L_rod = λ_rod/2 λ_gas = 2 × distance between nodes, v_gas = f × λ_gas f same for rod and gas: f = v_rod / (2 L_rod) = v_gas / λ_gas? Actually λ_gas = 2×node separation Ratio: v_gas / v_rod = (node separation) / L_rod Valid: rod thin, Y known, gas ideal, tube diameter ≪ λ, dust light enough to move
